extDescription.message: Fill your Facebook Marketplace listings in one click from templates, never repeating titles or photos. You press Publish.

notifyPublish.message: Today is a posting day on Marketplace. Open the extension and fill your listing.

notifyRenew.message: Today is a renew day for your Marketplace listings.

todayPublishText.message: Open Create listing, choose a template and press Fill.

todayRenewText.message: No new post today: renew your listings from Your listings.

todayOffText.message: Today is not a posting day.

noTemplates.message: No templates yet. Create one in the dashboard (⚙).

noTitles.message: No unused titles left. Add new titles or variables to the template.

noImages.message: No unused photos left. Add new photos to the template.

lowStock.message: Heads up: only {0} posts left with this template.

fillOk.message: Done. Review the form and press Publish on Facebook.

fillError.message: Could not fill. Reload the Facebook page (F5) and try again.

captureNeedsFb.message: Open a Marketplace form with data to save it as a template.

captureEmpty.message: The form is empty. Enter at least the title.

templatesHelp.message: Each template is a reusable draft. When filling, a title and photo never published before are used.

noTemplatesLong.message: No templates yet. Press “+ New template” or, from Facebook, use “Save form as template” in the extension.

confirmDelete.message: Delete this template and its photos? This cannot be undone.

exactTextHelp.message: Type category, condition and location exactly as Facebook shows them. If they don't match, the extension will ask you to pick them manually.

titlesHelp.message: One title per line. You can use variables like {beneficio}, {ciudad} or {precio}. Each title is posted only once.

descriptionsHelp.message: Separate each version with a line containing only ---. They rotate and also accept variables.

variablesHelp.message: One per line: name = value1 | value2. Titles combine with every value. Built-in: {precio}, {ciudad}, {cliente} and {fecha}.

imagesHelp.message: JPG, PNG or WEBP. Each photo is posted only once. Stored only in this browser.

reminderHelp.message: Chrome must be open to receive the reminder.

upcomingHelp.message: Change a single day: post, renew only or skip.

historyHelp.message: Titles and photos in published entries are never reused. Deleting an entry frees them.

deleteEntryHelp.message: Frees the title and photos for reuse

confirmDeleteEntry.message: Delete this entry? Its title and photos can be used again.

confirmClearHistory.message: Clear all history? All titles and photos may be repeated.

backupHelp.message: Download a file with templates, photos, history and settings. Use it to move your data to another computer.

confirmImport.message: Importing will replace ALL your current data. Continue?

importError.message: The file is not a valid DN Marketplace Helper backup.

aboutText.message: DN Marketplace Helper by DigitalNeg. Free software under the MIT license.

disclaimer.message: This tool is not affiliated with Meta or Facebook. It only fills the form: you review and publish. Each user is responsible for following Facebook Marketplace rules.

privacyShort.message: Privacy: all your data stays in this browser. The extension never sends information to any server.

promoteOff.message: “Boost after publishing” is always kept off so no ads are charged.

suggestHelp.message: Write benefits and features; the extension builds ready-to-use descriptions and tags. You can edit them afterwards.

featuresPh.message:
Sizes S to XXL
Heavy-duty PVC

priceRounded.message: Facebook doesn't accept cents: it will be posted as {0}.

needsLogin.message: Log in to Facebook and press Publish again.

formTimeout.message: The Marketplace form took too long to load. Please try again.
